text_block_list.text: Over the last few training sessions, Gold City's progress has been somewhat stagnant.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ugh, I just can't! How can I be this off when I'm so on point when modeling?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Wait… Maybe that's the key. I should imagine I'm on the runway.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: (It's like parading the final outfit at a show. Gotta make an impact with every step.)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: (A long stride to assert dominance. One foot in front of the other, no hesitation.)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: (Give them a show with the turn. Sharp and bold. Center of gravity steady, no faltering.)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh… of course. Keeping full control over my movements is my specialty.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: If I keep that mentality when running…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Trainer, weren't there a few videos in your office explaining running form?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Show me all of them! There's something I want to try.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: (Arm swing needs to be more forceful… My ankles aren't absorbing the shock of hitting the ground…)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: Amazing! That's a really good time!
Amazing! That's a really good time!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Guess the key was visualizing what I'm supposed to be doing. There's still room for improvement, though!
This improvement in Gold City's form has increased the sharpness of her running.
